newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to up 0.05.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to up 0.05.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open unchanged to 0.05 cent firmer Tuesday, dealers said.

Follow-through buying could lift the benchmark October contract to nearby resistance at 11.22 cents a lb, where buy stops are rumored to be resting. The next upside target was pegged at 11.34 cents, followed by 11.50 cents.
Volume is expected to remain thin, however, following Monday's July expiry, and the Fourth of July holiday on Friday.
Monday, spot July expired at 11.00 cents, up 0.08. October settled 0.05 cent firmer at 11.19 cents. The rest rose 0.05 cent.
The July/October switch went out at 0.19 cent premium basis October, from 0.22 on the previous close.
An estimated 15,718 lots changed hands on the day.

LIFFE white sugar futures were trading higher on Tuesday, amid buying by the trade. At 0840 EDT/1240 GMT, the spot August contract stood $1.40 higher at $322.60, while the rest of the board was trading $1.30 to $0.40 weaker.
